verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents custom dashboards: user-configured collections of charts for the metrics that matter to your application, which can be split by run tag or metadata. Prebuilt per-project dashboards also cover error rates and token usage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that custom dashboard charts can plot latency, cost, and eval/feedback scores (those metrics are only named in the alerts docs, which cover a different feature); independent or hands-on corroboration of custom dashboard building.
